name: Opay Ltd
summary: OPay Limited provides digital financial services in Singapore, Nigeria, Indonesia, Egypt, and Pakistan. The company operates through two segments: Digital Wallets and Banking, and Credit Business. The company's Digital Wallets and Banking segment offers a consumer wallet for storing value, peer-to-peer transfers, deposits, and withdrawals through the OPay app. It enables cashless payments through QR code scanning, merchant identifiers, USSD, SMS, and the Pay with OPay checkout for online merchants.
